ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (36) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 19, 34, 35 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

The old man's dialect word «кутята» (kutyata, 'puppies') is kept in transliteration so that Tolstoy's footnote still glosses it, and his garbled Slavonic John 1:18 is given in a slightly archaic register; «охотницкий колокол» (okhotnitsky kolokol) is read as 'volunteers' bell' (the website's 'hunting bell' was a misreading). The pun «прощай» (proshchai, 'farewell', literally 'forgive') / «Нечего прощать» (nechego proshchat', 'there's nothing to forgive') cannot survive in English; the sect names are transliterated or given their usual English forms.
